unavailableTitle: The Niihon service is not responding
unavailableBody: Check that Niihon is running on this computer, then try again.
incompatibleBody: This page was built for another version of the Niihon service. Reload the page; if the message remains, update Niihon.
incompatibleVersions: Service API version {serverVersion}; this page expects version {clientVersion}.
errorBody: The Niihon service could not complete the request.
notFoundBody: No page of Niihon has this address.
